title: Instrumented profile generator with dataset & prompt registry for onboarding
creator: Aisha Chen
description: Problem: Model onboarding currently produces performance profiles in an ad-hoc way: datasets and prompt sets are copied into per-run buckets and eval runners are special-cased. This makes profiles hard to reproduce, pin, and surface in the model catalog. Scope: implement a repeatable, instrumented profile generation flow that centralizes dataset + prompt versioning, provides an immutable profile artifact with provenance, and integrates with the model catalog UI for publishing and pinning. Deliverables: (1) lightweight Dataset + Prompt Registry (metadata only) with versioned identifiers and aliases; (2) instrumented profile generator job (CI/runner) that uses registry entries to run evals across configured eval runners and emits a single profile artifact JSON with metadata (dataset_id, prompt_set_id, model_version, runner_version, hardware_tags, kernel_profile, token-distribution metrics); (3) publish pipeline to upload artifacts to S3 and register the profile with the model catalog (including checksums and schema version); (4) minimal console integration to show published profiles and allow pinning to a model variant.
comments: 2025-02-10 - Triage: ticket created after demo with PM showing unreliable profile reproductions. Assigned to Mateo.

2025-02-12 - Design review notes: prefer metadata-only registry (no raw data) to avoid storage duplication; agree on dataset_id format 'ds:<slug>:v<semver>'. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/MOB/Dataset+and+Prompt+Registry

2025-02-14 - Implementation update: proto registry API and migration script sketched. Added dataset and prompt registry tables in staging DB. PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/2987

2025-02-17 - Testing: ran profile generator on llama-3b variant; observed spike in token-distribution variance when batch_size > 32. Filed follow-up performance ticket ENG-14402 to tune runner batching defaults.
2025-02-19 - Review feedback from Research: request to include 'warmup_kv_hits' metric and runner git-sha in artifact. Will add to schema v2.
2025-02-20 - Blocker: missing curated prompt translations for multilingual dataset - waiting on PM to prioritize. Linked PM ticket PM-358.
acceptance_criteria: Profile generator consumes dataset_id and prompt_set_id from registry instead of raw file paths
Generated profile artifact includes model_version, runner_version, hardware_tags, kernel_profile, token_histogram, latency_p50/p95/p99, and checksum
CI pipeline creates profile artifact and uploads to S3 with a canonical path and registers metadata in the model catalog
Console shows published profile and a 'Pin this profile' action that associates profile with a model variant
All artifacts are schema-versioned; schema v2 includes warmup_kv_hits and runner_git_sha
steps: Create registry schema and lightweight HTTP API for dataset and prompt metadata
Write migration to backfill existing eval-run artifacts into registry entries where possible
Extend benchmark harness to accept registry IDs instead of file paths and to emit the instrumented profile JSON
Add instrumentation hooks for kernel selection, kv cache hits, batching metrics, and token distribution
Implement CI job that runs on model-onboard branch, uploads artifacts to S3, and calls model-catalog publish API
Add console backend endpoint to list published profiles and wire a minimal frontend placeholder for pinning
Document registry ID formats, artifact schema, and a developer guide for adding new eval runners
